name: Ak Bars Bank
note: Official bank of FC Rubin; name on the upper front and logo patch on the sleeve of the 2026-27 home shirt (official club store product photos, 2026-10-03). Its own register page (Wayback, Jan 2021 capture) lists Tatarstan state bodies and companies with over 50% combined as of 29 Oct 2020, and Cbonds' profile reproduces the same list today; Svyazinvestneftekhim, the republic's holding vehicle, states on its own site that its sole shareholder is the Republic of Tatarstan (Kommersant reported 100% state ownership in 2009). Later registers could not be opened (akbars.ru blocks this network, e-disclosure.ru returns 403, and its 2025 published IFRS statements redact shareholder detail as sensitive information). Sponsor kept unrated; tier decision deferred to a maintainer.
